title: Store: a room record never becomes active again after leaving
description: Found while building the IRC front end (mimid-1vul.8). Store::leave marks a room record Leaving and Event::Left marks it Left (crates/mimid-agent-store/src/action.rs, sync.rs apply). If the user is later invited to the same room URI again and joins, Store::room_for returns the existing record by URI without touching its status (sync.rs room_for, reconcile_rooms), so the record stays Leaving/Left. The IRC front end shows only Active rooms, so a rejoined room never appears as a channel. Unverified by a test; nothing else sets status back to Active. Fix: in reconcile_rooms/room_for, set status Active (and record RoomChanged) when the agent reports the room Active and the record is not.
close_reason: Real bug, confirmed by a failing test (record stayed Left after rejoin). Fixed in 8d072a6 on branch irc-fixes: reconcile_rooms reactivates the record; stale Event::Left dropped. Test: crates/mimid-agent/tests/irc.rs a_room_left_and_joined_again_is_shown_again.
